title: Jonathan Wright Reportedly Back In Jail On Assault Charge Just A Month After His Release - NewsBreak
text:
By Tiara B ,
8 hours ago Just last month, celebrity hairstylist and Zeus reality star Jonathan Wright was all smiles after being released from jail following time served on a gun charge. However, it looks like Wright has found himself in trouble with the law once again.
RELATED: Asian Doll Responds After Jonathan Wright Says He Felt Let Down By Friends While In Jail (VIDEO) Jonathan Wright Reportedly Arrested In Dallas County On Thursday, October 22, Jonathan Wright sparked buzz on social media after a new mugshot began circulating online. The photo shows the celebrity hairstylist wearing a white hoodie following his arrest in Dallas County, Texas.
According to Dallas County jail records, Wright was apparently booked during the early hours of October 22, 2026, on an assault charge involving bodily injury. His bond was set at $10,000.
Social Media Reacts Social media users gathered under The Shade Room’s post as they reacted to Jonathan Wright’s latest arrest. While some expressed disappointment, others joked about the situation and called for his release.
Instagram user @parisalayaa wrote, “LMA its not funny but he be tearing ppl UP!”
Instagram user @ adore357 added, “ Oh damn free Jonathan again fr”
While Instagram user @_shanta wrote, “ Ohhh come on Jonathan we were just excited for your return”
Instagram user @boujiee_babyg commented, “ Omg we need u for bad boyssss wtf”
Instagram user @xoanthony1 added, “@ realmissnatalienunn come bail him out!”
While Instagram user @stylishteo wrote, “ These days you gotta stay in the house 😂people will have me getting arrested every other day”
Instagram user @lajeelovesyou_ commented, “ He might as well be a mma fighter or something”
Instagram user @_.843nootie added, “ Lmaoo that picture tell me he did it and he’ll do it again”
While Instagram user @lo_london wrote, “ Y’all need to leave fren alone!”
Here’s What Jonathan Wright Was Doing Before His Latest Arrest Prior to his latest arrest, Jonathan Wright appeared to be enjoying his time back out of jail. He wasted no time returning to Instagram and sharing updates with his followers.
In one post , he wrote, “First Week FREE. And the Comeback already Louder than the Sentence. DONT GET COMFORTABLE.”
Throughout October, Jonathan spent time getting back into doing hair and even visited James Madison High School.
In the days leading up to his arrest, he continued sharing updates on his Instagram Story. At one point, he revealed that he had regained access to his assistant and even made his way back into the studio.
One of his final posts before his arrest showed him enjoying a night out at the club with the caption, “ Enjoy life .”
